cars.generation: Original Samba production-road sporting hatchback family
cars.specification_market: French 1219 cc Samba Rallye production-road reference documented in the 1983 base A-5157 recognition and N-5157 supplement. Stock/base identification, layout and mechanical fields only; not optional Group A gear ratios, cages, competition suspension/brakes, enlarged maximum permitted bore/capacity, Group B 232 evolutions or prepared race output. No horsepower, torque, performance, competition minimum weight, production total or exact road-registration approval is inferred from the forms. The 1360 cc UK S and later Rallye variants remain distinct specifications within this one family. The photograph illustrates the original road hatchback body in GL trim, not Rallye equipment.
cars.summary: The Samba Rallye was a purpose-developed sub-1300 cc sporting road hatchback and a foundation for Talbot’s customer rallying programme. Its 1219 cc engine with twin Weber carburettors and five-speed front-drive layout, together with documented FIA production recognition, give it a genuine place among early French rally-oriented hot hatches. One original Samba family is counted. The different 1360 cc UK Samba S, later engine versions, badges and competition evolutions do not add separate entries.
